content.text:
HEAD requests through `shelf_router` now keep the handler's content-length. A HEAD to a route returning `'hello-world'` gives `content-length: 11` with an empty body, where it used to give `0`. I checked this with a throwaway script that I then deleted. The existing `shelf_router` tests pass, and I didn't add a new test.

The fix is in `_removeBody` in `pkgs/shelf_router/lib/src/router.dart`. It no longer overwrites content-length and only replaces the body with an empty one. Shelf already keeps an explicitly set content-length when the body is empty, so nothing else was needed. I also added a short doc comment citing RFC 9110 §9.3.2.
